---
title: "Scale-Out & Reproducibility"
description: "Take a working experiment to a cluster, generate standalone code, and make the result reproducible."
---

A model that runs on a laptop still has to survive a parameter sweep, a cluster, and
somebody else's machine a year later. This topic covers generating code, distributing
work, and shipping an experiment that reproduces.

## Do

- [Distributed workflows](DistributedWorkflows.qmd) — emit, submit and finalize work
  across a cluster.
- [Code generation & export](CodeGeneration.qmd) — render an experiment to standalone
  JAX, Julia, CUDA, LEMS, BIDS or openMINDS.
- [HPC patterns](../CLI/hpc.qmd) and [CLI recipes](../CLI/recipes.qmd) — end-to-end
  cluster runs from the command line.

## Understand

- [Backends & capability matrix](../CLI/backends.qmd) — what each backend supports and
  how work is dispatched.
- [Workflow kits](../CLI/workflow-kits.qmd) — what a packaged cluster kit contains and
  why it is structured that way.
